snippet.title: Times of Survival Early development Gameplay trailer
snippet.description:
The old world is dead,  A decade ago, it was consumed by an unknown plague. But in the ashes of civilization, humanity refuses to surrender. You're the one of the few with the guts to stand against the zombies. 
It's not about being a hero, but surviving at all costs.
Fight for survival alongside friends or brave the apocalypse alone in Times of Survival, a brutal AA-quality cooperative experience. Explore the world and craft a wide arsenal of weaponry to stand against zombie threat.

Your actions shape the course of the global war – reclaim territory, aid desperate settlements, and become the spark that reignites hope for humanity.
Together we can snatch our world back from the jaws of the dead.

JOIN THE BATTLE TODAY!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2999040/Times_of_Survival/

Join community: https://discord.gg/2FjJSRZKhY

Visit our Website: https://www.timesofsurvival.com/
